gramatica.titulo: Patterns: marcar a visita com at, on e in

personagens.YARA: a Brazilian woman technician (thirties, brown skin, shoulder-length curly black hair, dark navy work shirt and pants)
personagens.CUSTOMER: a farm owner (forties, dark brown skin, shaved head and a short black beard, light gray polo shirt, dark jeans and brown boots)

gramatica.cenaAbertura: Wide view of a sunny farm yard at mid-morning, with a big machine shed and green fields behind it. {YARA} steps out of a small white service pickup truck with a toolbox in her hand, and {CUSTOMER} walks over from a green tractor with a big welcoming smile.

slides.cena: Early morning in a small GPS repair workshop: {YARA} looks at her wristwatch as she carries a toolbox toward the open door, while a large round wall clock with simple tick marks and no numbers hangs above the workbench. She is alone in the workshop.

frases.en: I can be there **at** nine o'clock.
frases.pt: Posso estar aí às nove em ponto.

frases.en: The appointment is **at** half past ten.
frases.pt: O horário marcado é às dez e meia.

frases.en: I'll be there **at** two in the afternoon.
frases.pt: Vou estar aí às duas da tarde.

frases.en: We're busy until three, but we're free **at** four.
frases.pt: Estamos ocupados até as três, mas livres às quatro.

frases.en: The farm is far, so I'll leave **at** seven.
frases.pt: A fazenda é longe, então vou sair às sete.

frases.en: Let's meet **at** half past two, then.
frases.pt: Então vamos nos encontrar às duas e meia.

slides.cena: In his small farm office, {CUSTOMER} talks on his phone and points at a big paper wall calendar made of blank squares, with one square circled in green, while a cup of coffee sits on his desk.

frases.en: Are you free **on** Monday?
frases.pt: Você está livre na segunda?

frases.en: The customer is busy all day **on** Monday.
frases.pt: O cliente está ocupado o dia todo na segunda.

frases.en: Can we meet **on** Tuesday morning?
frases.pt: Podemos nos encontrar na terça de manhã?

frases.en: My schedule is full **on** Wednesday.
frases.pt: Minha agenda está cheia na quarta.

frases.en: See you **on** Thursday afternoon!
frases.pt: Até quinta à tarde!

frases.en: The next visit is **on** June tenth.
frases.pt: A próxima visita é no dia 10 de junho.

slides.cena: Morning on a long dirt road between wide green soybean fields: {YARA} drives a small white service pickup truck toward a distant farmhouse, with the low morning sun glowing amber over the hills.

frases.en: We are very busy **in** March.
frases.pt: Estamos muito ocupados em março.

frases.en: I can come **in** the morning.
frases.pt: Posso ir aí de manhã.

frases.en: Is the visit **in** the morning or **in** the afternoon?
frases.pt: A visita é de manhã ou à tarde?

frases.en: We have a lot of visits **in** October.
frases.pt: A gente tem muitas visitas em outubro.

frases.en: I'll confirm by message **in** the evening.
frases.pt: Vou confirmar por mensagem à noite.

frases.en: **In** the rainy season, the farm roads are bad.
frases.pt: Na época das chuvas, as estradas das fazendas ficam ruins.

slides.cena: In a sunny field, {CUSTOMER} sits in the open cab of a green tractor, phone at his ear and one finger on his chin, thinking, while the GPS display beside him shows only a dark screen.

frases.en: **Does** Thursday **work** for you?
frases.pt: Quinta funciona pra você?

frases.en: Monday is difficult. **Can we meet** on Wednesday?
frases.pt: Segunda é difícil. Podemos nos encontrar na quarta?

frases.en: **Does** nine o'clock **work** for you?
frases.pt: Às nove funciona pra você?

frases.en: **Can we meet** after lunch?
frases.pt: Podemos nos encontrar depois do almoço?

frases.en: **Does** the afternoon **work** better for you?
frases.pt: A tarde funciona melhor pra você?

frases.en: Eight is too early. **Can we meet** at half past nine?
frases.pt: Oito é muito cedo. Podemos nos encontrar às nove e meia?

revisao.en: My last appointment today is **at** five.
revisao.pt: Meu último compromisso hoje é às cinco.

revisao.en: The customer cancelled, so the visit is **on** Friday now.
revisao.pt: O cliente cancelou, então agora a visita é na sexta.
Os monitores novos chegam em maio.
Dez e meia funciona pra você?

gramatica.cenaRevisao: At sunset on the farm, next to a big machine shed, {CUSTOMER} shakes hands with {YARA} beside a green tractor, both smiling, while the GPS display in its open cab glows with a simple green check mark icon.
